Launcher

One program that finds your Assetto Corsa install, keeps the openASC engine up to date, installs mods and starts a drive.

PlatformFileNeeds
Windows x64DownloadWindows 10 or 11, a GPU with Vulkan or DirectX 12
Linux x86-64Downloadglibc, X11 or Wayland, Vulkan GPU

You also need your own copy of Assetto Corsa (2014). openASC contains no game content. Releases are listed on GitHub; the launcher is built from crates/asc-launcher.

What it does

  • Finds the game. Looks in the Steam library folders, or you pick the folder.
  • Updates the engine. Downloads the newest openASC build from GitHub Releases and checks its SHA-256 before installing.
  • Installs mods. Browse the mod catalog, install, update or remove with one click. Every download is checked against the catalog hash.
  • Starts a drive. Prepares a workspace that points at your game folder, then runs the engine with the scenario you choose.

Current limits

The engine is a driving workbench, not a full game yet (see progress). The launcher starts the scenarios the engine can run today. The launcher has not been code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first start.

openASC is an independent project, not affiliated with Kunos Simulazioni. Game content is not included.
